observations: Large rectangular photovoltaic panel with dark cells and white grid lines
Silver aluminum frame around the panel perimeter
Panel leaning vertically against an interior plastered wall
Watermark text "INNOSON GLOBAL GROUP" overlaid across the center of the image
No visible brand label, model number, or specification sticker on the panel face
Tiled floor at bottom and window frame at right edge

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a single panel only; no inverter, batteries, charge controller, or wiring visible to confirm a complete system

risks.risk: Panel may not produce electricity due to dead cells or internal faults
risks.proof: Video of the panel in daylight connected to a multimeter showing voltage and current output

risks.risk: Hidden physical damage such as cracks, delamination, or backsheet damage
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the panel back label, frame corners, and cell surface under angled light

risks.risk: Age and usage history unknown, output may be degraded
risks.proof: Photo of manufacturing date sticker or original purchase receipt

risks.risk: Item may be only one panel rather than a full solar energy system
risks.proof: Photo showing inverter, charge controller, batteries, and mounting hardware together

proof_requests: Photo of the back label showing wattage, voltage, and manufacturer
Video of the panel under daylight with a multimeter connected
Close-up photos of the panel surface and frame for cracks or damage
response.reason: The item is visually identifiable as a solar panel by type, so it can be priced at its worst case as non-working and unverified condition; no model number is required for this category.
